objective: Audit original author revision images with registration control, don't infer styled handwriting technique from slide alignment.

sources.author: Zheng Chuyang / Typotheque
sources.author_documented_context: Before/after colored outlines of 阝 component; 口 was widened then rolled back in a distinct family-wide review, do not equate these as one author edit
sources.source_rights: Research citation and aggregate measurements only; no copyright image or font model-training license assumed.

experiments.caveat: Unregistered visual overlay distances confound design revision and placement.

experiments.fit_region: Upper 50% of colored outline left ROI
experiments.holdout_region: Lower 50% of SAME source display image, not a new character, so NOT cross-glyph validation
experiments.caveat: Heldout geometric residual can reflect actual revision, antialiasing, line labels, print display alignment or threshold errors; not aesthetic or author's editable path.

critical_correction: The 30 px median separation from the source image is NOT the author's net radical adjustment: 36 px overall horizontal display alignment offset explains most median edge separation; after alignment residual median ~2 px and a nontrivial high-distance tail remain. No universal correction magnitude can be derived.
impacts_previous_work: Supersedes naive interpretation of unregistered color-contour distance as shape-edit magnitude in R10 notes.
Keeps source confidence for same-component revision and family re-evaluation, but makes numeric shape-edit magnitude explicitly UNKNOWN.
No new source picture redrawing, no added glyph simulation, no manipulated font ratios.

admissible_learning.decision: Re-evaluate shared component revisions across positions and densities; undo seemingly stylish edits if family coherence suffers.
When compressing a font, inspect local counters/joins rather than assume whole-character scale is an aesthetic fix.
admissible_learning.evidence: Creator-labeled revision figure, but not universally transferable to ink calligraphy.

admissible_learning.decision: Full authored glyph silhouette is designed in stages from structural study, not recovered by uniform stroke width alone.
admissible_learning.evidence: Published multi-stage visual, no unique motion/pressure inference.

not_yet: Reproducible creator gesture synthesis on previously unseen glyph
time_and_money: No new paid subscription or model API; GitHub Actions CPU and existing network tools only.
next_recommended_work: Do not tune another scalar or post-image width. Use genuine creator-before/after examples only as critic/rollback signal across an entire family of glyphs, with true holdout and human aesthetic evaluation.
